articles.summary: Dole plc (NYSE: DOLE) today announced that management will participate in the Stephens Annual Investment Conference to be held November 17-19, 2026, in Nashville, Tennessee. Management will participate in a fireside chat at 8:45 a.m. CT on November 19 and will conduct one-on-one meetings with investors attending the conference on that day. To schedule a meeting with management, please contact your Stephens representative. A live webcast of the fireside chat and a replay following the event will be available through the Events Presentations section of Dole’s Investor Relations website: www.doleplc.com/investor-relations/events-and-presentations . About Dole plc: A global leader in fresh produce, Dole plc grows, markets, and distributes an extensive variety of fresh fruits and vegetables sourced locally and from around the world. Dedicated to exceeding our customers' requirements in more than 85 countries, our goal is to make the world a healthier and more sustainable place.
articles.title: Dole plc to Participate in the Stephens Annual Investment Conference

articles.summary: Dole plc (NYSE: DOLE) ("Dole" or the "Group" or the "Company") today released its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.
